_README: WhatsApp message templates, as registered with Meta.
Each key here is an outbound message KIND (matching notify.send_whatsapp's
`kind` argument). A kind with no entry can only be sent inside the 24-hour
session window; outside it, the send is blocked and recorded rather than
handed to Meta to reject.
FIELDS
name       Template name EXACTLY as registered in Meta. Lowercase,
digits and underscores only - Meta rejects anything else.
language   Language/locale code EXACTLY as registered, e.g. en_US, en_GB,
ur. A mismatch here fails at send time with error 132001,
which reads like the template does not exist.
body_text  The approved body text, with {{1}}, {{2}} ... placeholders.
Kept here so the outbox can show what the customer actually
received, and so a variable-count mismatch is caught locally
instead of at Meta.
variables  Ordered list of value names filling {{1}}, {{2}} ... The names
come from the same vocabulary the free-text confirmation uses:
name, business, service, date, time, vehicle, id.
NOTHING HERE TAKES EFFECT UNTIL THE TEMPLATE IS APPROVED BY META.
See the WhatsApp template checklist in SETUP.md.

booking_confirmation.name: booking_confirmation
booking_confirmation.body_text: Hi {{1}}! Your {{2}} at {{3}} is confirmed for {{4}} at {{5}}. Booking #{{6}}. Reply here if you need to change anything.

_note: Meta pre-approves `hello_world` on every WhatsApp Business account, so
this one needs NO registration and works the moment your credentials are
in. It is the only template you can rely on before approving your own.
It is declared here because 'Send test' on the dashboard exists to check
a number you have never messaged - which is, by definition, outside the
24-hour window. Without an entry here that check could never run.
The wording is fixed by Meta and ignores whatever you type in the test
box: outside the window, Meta renders its own approved body. Inside the
window your typed message is sent as free text instead.
test.name: hello_world
test.body_text:
Hello World

Welcome and congratulations!! This message demonstrates your ability to send a WhatsApp message notification from the Cloud API, hosted by Meta. To learn more, please visit our website.
